name: Final Exam
source:
The semester is almost over, but you still have a bunch of essays to grade. Working late at your school, you'll both have to fight your inner demons, as well as outside ones...

Will you survive your FINAL EXAM?

[From [url=https://johanofkarlsson.itch.io/final-exam]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
学期快结束了，但你还有一堆论文要批改。在学校加班到很晚，你们都必须与内心的恶魔以及外在的恶魔作斗争……

你能通过期末考试吗？

[来自[url=https://johanofkarlsson.itch.io/final-exam]Itch.io[/url]]
